text:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up — summarizing owners for remediation + proposed test/eval additions from last night (KV eviction cascade). I pushed a rough plan below, need signoffs and ETA. TL;DR: regression promptset + nightly load job + small chaos drill.
adrian: thanks. can you add owners per item?
maria: sure, assigning: promptset -> @lina; nightly load -> @dave; chaos drill -> @adrian + @sam for infra. target ETA: 2w for promptset, 1w for load job, 3w for drill prep. notes: promptset needs 20 edge cases from postmortem logs.
lina: I can take promptset. will import logs and start curating subset. estimate 10 biz days. can we get the logs s3 path?
maria: s3://redwood-postmortem/kv-evict/2026-03-22/ - contains sample traces + minimal transcripts. Also added a small script to extract prompts: 
```bash
python tools/extract_prompts.py --src s3://redwood-postmortem/... --out tests/promptsets/kv-evict.jsonl
```
dave: taking nightly load job. will wire into k8s cronjob and run against staging pool. can we limit tokens per request to 256 to match incident patterns?
maria: yes limit=256. scheduler cron: 
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
schedule: "0 3 * * *"
jobTemplate:
  spec:
    template:
      spec:
        containers:
        - name: load-gen
          image: ghcr.io/redwood/loadgen:latest
          args: ["--target-staging", "--rate", "50", "--max-tokens", "256"]
```
adrian: for chaos drill I'd like a scoped plan: small KV eviction sim on staging, ramped traffic, health probes to verify KV hit rate and graceful fallback. @oncall-bot can we schedule a short 2-hour window next Friday?
oncall-bot: @adrian scheduling window request received. Need 48h approval from IR team. Suggested window: 2026-04-02 10:00-12:00 UTC. React with :thumbsup: to approve.
sam: I'll help with infra hooks and rollbacks. also can we add a fallback model variant to the routing policy for the drill?
maria: good call. adding routing fallback to model-variant "small-latency-safe". config diff:
```diff
- route: primary-model
+ route: primary-model
  fallback: small-latency-safe
```
lina: question: how will promptset be integrated into evals pipeline? need format and gating rules.
maria: will add to evals repo under evals/regressions/kv-evict/ with a CI job that fails PRs if regression > 3% degradation on BLEU-like metric (we use a custom similarity score). I'll open PR to add the job.
dave: ETA check-in: planning to have a test deploy on staging by 1767720000 (a week). will post a link to job when ready.
adrian: ownership and timelines look ok from me. one ask: add recurring postmortem check every quarter to look for pattern recurrence. can someone add a GH issue?
maria: created issue: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/1428 — quarterly recurrence review. assigned to @adrian.
lina: ack, starting promptset curation now. will post interim sample tomorrow.
sam: ack for chaos drill support. will review rollback playbook.
maria: action list recap:
- lina: build promptset + add to evals (ETA 10 biz days)
- dave: nightly load job + staging deploy (ETA 1 week)
- adrian + sam: chaos drill plan + run (ETA 3 weeks, schedule pending approval)
- maria: add CI gating + create GH issue for quarterly reviews, push PRs

maria: marking items as blockers if not started by EOD Tue. ping @here for visibility :eyes:
dave: small nit: can we add a health-check metric to console: kv_hit_rate and fallback_rate?
maria: yes will file a console metric ticket.
oncall-bot: Reminder: please confirm window approval by 1767640000 to meet 48h lead time.
adrian: adding :thumbsup: — approved.
lina: sample promptset uploaded: https://storage.redwood.ai/promptsets/kv-evict-sample.jsonl
sam: noted. thanks everyone.
